🎮 GTA 6 runs smoother on Xbox Series X than PS5, according to Digital Foundry

A new Digital Foundry comparison of the base PS5 and Xbox Series X versions of GTA 6 found Xbox holds a steadier 30fps, while PS5 drops frames more often — especially in fast vehicle chases. Visuals are nearly matched, with only minor resolution edges favoring Series X. DF calls GTA 6's performance "balanced on a knife's edge," since both consoles still dip below 30fps at times. The PS5 Pro version reportedly still looks best overall, thanks to near-4K visuals and ray-traced shadows.

🕒 Published: Nov 25, 12:51 AM (GMT+3)

📰 Sources: Video Games Chronicle (via Digital Foundry)
https://www.videogameschronicle.com/news/gta-6-has-more-framerate-drops-on-ps5-than-xbox-series-x-according-to-analysis/
